resource_limitations: Global wall and measured-CPU acceptance budgets include B2, every failed trial, final native validation and monitor CPU. CPU is checked after stages/completion, not preempted by the OS. Process-group and workdir polling guards can overshoot; no process-tree memory quota or full orphan CPU accounting is claimed. Stored totals precede the last receipt write; both caps are checked after it.
